summary: Round 2: baseline spec orders/listing requires cursor pagination, but the request implies page numbers; an explicit MODIFIED decision is needed before the spec is consistent.

findings.problem: Baseline 'Requirement: Cursor pagination' says all list endpoints SHALL use opaque cursors; REQ-3 draft uses page numbers ('page 2'). Writing REQ-3 as-is contradicts the accepted contract without a delta.
findings.expected_fix: Next round: either express REQ-3 with cursors (URL keeps cursor + filter) or add a MODIFIED delta for listing with justification; options-review must reconsider OPT-A accordingly.

checked_criteria: F-1 addressed: REQ-1 now has foreign-user scenario
F-2 addressed: AC-2 states invalid filter response
Baseline specs under openspec/specs read in full

requirements.text: The history SHALL contain only operations owned by the authenticated user.
The user SHALL filter history by operation type and date range.
History SHALL be paginated and filter and page SHALL survive a reload.

intent_map.intent: pagination works together with filter, also after reload

acceptance_criteria.observable: GET /api/history as user A returns only rows owned by A.
Invalid type filter returns 400 with a field error.
After reload the same page of filtered results is shown.
